title: jig UI references of a branch
description: .jig/ui/<branch>/references.json, written by jig ui reference. Its existence is the declaration that step 2 of flow ui was done.

none.description: Why the task has no reference (the user said so, answered, or is away)

source.description: Opaque: a URL, path or artifact name, exactly as the user gave it

covers.description: The screen or state the reference shows; jig ui prove compares its image with the combinations it names

image.description: PNG under the branch folder, set by jig ui reference attach --image

tree.description: Tree under the branch folder (schema/ui-tree.schema.json), set by jig ui reference attach --tree
